meta.title: Siaya climate, water and resilience evidence by source
meta.rule: Aggregates only; no individuals. Every value keeps its own source, page, period, unit, kind and confidence. Allocation, receipt, transfer and expenditure are separate kinds in separate series and are never summed or compared as if one were the other. No allocation or expenditure is treated as an outcome. Hazard rankings are copied as printed; where the source prints no ranking the entry says so. Missing values are listed in gaps, never filled.

confidence_scale.5: Official statistical table with a stated definition and adequate sample
confidence_scale.4: Primary table in the issuing body's own publication, read as printed
confidence_scale.3: Primary source, but the definition is not stated, the layout is ambiguous or the value is a narrative statement
confidence_scale.2: Value read from a chart label or with an unclear denominator
confidence_scale.1: Secondary report whose original source is not named

definitions.kind: allocation = budgeted amount; receipt = cash received from a grant; transfer = money moved into a county fund; expenditure = actual spending; coverage = share or count of people/households with a service; hazard ranking = hazard named by a source, with any ranking as printed; outcome = measured result of an intervention (none recorded yet)
definitions.series: Observations that may be plotted together. Every series holds one kind and one unit only.
definitions.pdf_page: 1-based page of the PDF file; printed_page is the footer number, null when the document prints none
definitions.quote: A short string that appears on pdf_page, used to re-find the value
definitions.ward_register_name: Ward name as printed in the CIDP 2023-2027 ward table (pdf p.28); see ward_register

ward_register.note: 30 County Assembly wards as listed in the CIDP 2023-2027. The IEBC register itself was not downloaded in this pass, so IEBC spellings (for example 'Yimbo East') are not verified.
